evidence: Updates IPC Cap'n Proto interface definitions (`src/ipc/capnp/mining.capnp`) and `src/interfaces/mining.h` to introduce `TxCollection` over the IPC boundary.
rationale: Expands the IPC mining interface to support external template validation without requiring consumers to mirror the node's mempool over IPC. The changes serve external mining callers directly (such as Stratum v2 Job Declarator Servers), improving interface completeness and reducing IPC bandwidth overhead.
